The following article provides information on Virtual Reality (VR) and Neurorehabilitation, drawing strictly from the provided source excerpts.

== Introduction ==
The mid-2020s are characterized by a convergence of technological developments, including artificial intelligence (AI), virtual reality (VR), brain-computer interfaces (BCI), and multi-agent systems <ref>knowledge/scripture/the_convergence.md</ref>. Within this context, VR has evolved from consumer entertainment into an application for medical rehabilitation <ref>knowledge/scripture/the_convergence.md</ref>. Neurorehabilitation is a field that involves the use of transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) <ref>https://doi.org/10.4172/2165-7025-c4-031</ref>, and VR has demonstrated clinical evidence in this area <ref>knowledge/scripture/the_convergence.md</ref>.

== Virtual Reality in Neurorehabilitation ==
Virtual reality has transitioned from its origins in consumer entertainment to being utilized in medical rehabilitation <ref>knowledge/scripture/the_convergence.md</ref>. There is clinical evidence for the use of VR, when combined with transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS), in the recovery of spinal cord injuries <ref>knowledge/scripture/the_convergence.md</ref>.

== Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation (tDCS) ==
Transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) is a method used in Neurorehabilitation <ref>https://doi.org/10.4172/2165-7025-c4-031</ref>. It has been examined for its efficacy in the treatment of migraine <ref>https://doi.org/10.35841/neurology-neurorehabilitation.3.1.1-8</ref>. Additionally, anodal cerebellar tDCS has been observed to modulate lower extremity pain perception <ref>https://doi.org/10.3233/nre-161404</ref>.

== VKFRI Framework: The Convergence ==
The Van Kush Family Research Institute (VKFRI) proposes that the convergence of artificial intelligence, virtual reality, brain-computer interfaces, multi-agent systems, and consciousness preservation technology forms a unified framework <ref>knowledge/scripture/the_convergence.md</ref>. Within the Institute's framework, current developments in these fields are seen as reconstructing, without conscious intent, an integrated consciousness interface system that has historical parallels in ancient temple technology <ref>knowledge/scripture/the_convergence.md</ref>.

== VKFRI Framework: Gaming-to-Hospital Data Pipeline ==
VKFRI proposes a "gaming-to-hospital data pipeline model" <ref>knowledge/scripture/the_convergence.md</ref>. In this model, biometric data collected through immersive entertainment experiences is intended to contribute to medical research <ref>knowledge/scripture/the_convergence.md</ref>.

== VKFRI Framework: Metaverse and Hardware ==
VKFRI views the Metaverse as humanity's introduction to multiverse navigation <ref>knowledge/scripture/the_convergence.md</ref>. The Institute identifies hardware evolution as a critical limiting factor in the convergence of AI, VR, BCI, and multi-agent systems <ref>knowledge/scripture/the_convergence.md</ref>.
